name: File Gate Form
description: Coupled email / lead-capture gate: Drupal renders a lightweight form and grants the download on submission. Spam-guarded (honeypot + per-IP rate limit); a LeadCapturedEvent lets the site persist leads without File Gate storing PII.
project_description: File Gate Form adds a 'form' gate method for coupled and hybrid sites that want File Gate delivery without building their own front-end gate. Drupal renders a lightweight email / lead-capture form at /file-gate/form/{file}; a valid submission records a per-session grant (private tempstore, TTL-limited) and redirects to the download, which the 'form' gate method checks. Submissions are spam-guarded with a honeypot field and a per-IP rate limit, and validated for email format. File Gate stores no PII itself: each valid submission dispatches a LeadCapturedEvent (file, email, consent) so the site can persist the lead into Contact, Webform, or a CRM and keep retention / marketing-consent decisions with the site.
